Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Globe Pendant Light with White Inner Shade & Rattan Outer Shade, 16"H, Natural Twine
Colors: Natural Twine
The white inner shade and rattan outer shade of this pendant light adds a beautiful brightness to any room you can dream of hanging it in. Frame your bed or couch by hanging two on either side, or provide warm light with a rustic feel over a dining room table. 16"W x 16"D x 16"H; hanging length: 77"H White inner shade with a rattan outer shade and a white cloth cord With hints of rustic design, this pendant lamp is ideal for any room in your home. 1 60-watt E26 bulb required; bulb not included Expert installation required For indoor use only
